roofing.hero: Roof leak repair and roof replacement in {location}. Compare the affected areas, flashing, decking, ventilation and material choices in a written scope before deciding whether to repair a section or replace the roof.

bathroom-remodeling.hero: Bathroom remodeling in {location}, from a shower and vanity update to a new room layout. Bring dimensions and finish ideas so the estimate can separate demolition, plumbing changes, waterproofing, tile, glass and installation.

kitchen-remodeling.hero: Kitchen remodeling in {location} with cabinets, countertops, backsplashes and lighting planned together. Confirm appliance dimensions and decide which plumbing and electrical locations will stay before comparing estimates for a finish update or a new layout.

flooring.description: Flooring installation in {location}. Plan LVP or tile, removal, subfloor preparation and trim with Luna General Contractors.

drywall.hero: Drywall repair in {location} for damaged walls, ceilings, cracks and access openings. Include texture matching, primer and painting boundaries in the estimate. For water-damaged areas, discuss the leak repair and drying status before planning the finish work.
drywall.description: Drywall and ceiling repair in {location}, including texture matching and finish planning. Request an estimate from Luna General Contractors.

backsplash-installation.hero: Kitchen backsplash installation in {location} with subway tile, mosaic and other selected patterns. Compare the tile layout, outlet cuts, exposed edges and wall preparation. Bring counter-to-cabinet measurements and a tile sample for a more complete estimate.
backsplash-installation.description: Kitchen backsplash installation in {location}. Plan tile patterns, outlet cuts and edge finishes with Luna General Contractors.

cabinet-installation.hero: Kitchen cabinet installation and replacement in {location}. Confirm cabinet sizes, appliance openings, fillers and finished end panels before ordering. The estimate should identify removal, installation, hardware and any countertop or wall repairs that are included.
cabinet-installation.description: Cabinet installation in {location}. Review layout, appliance openings, fillers and installation scope with Luna General Contractors.

water-damage-restoration.hero: Water damage restoration in {location}, including water extraction, structural drying and repair planning. Share the reported water source and affected rooms. Separate the drying scope and moisture records from later drywall, flooring and cabinet reconstruction.
water-damage-restoration.description: Water damage restoration in {location}: extraction, structural drying and repair planning with Luna General Contractors.

shower-remodeling.hero: Shower remodeling and tub-to-shower conversions in {location}. Plan the shower footprint, drain and valve locations, waterproofing system, tile and glass together. Discuss a bench, niche or lower entry early so the estimate reflects the complete design.
shower-remodeling.description: Shower remodeling and tub-to-shower conversions in {location}. Plan tile, waterproofing and glass with Luna General Contractors.

siding.hero: Siding repair and replacement in {location}, including fiber-cement and other selected exterior systems. Compare a localized repair with a full wall replacement after reviewing the existing material, trim, flashing and any concealed damage found during removal.
siding.description: Siding repair and replacement in {location}. Review exterior materials, trim and repair boundaries with Luna General Contractors.

window-replacement.description: Window replacement in {location}. Compare opening conditions, installation options and trim work with Luna General Contractors.

door-installation.hero: Interior and exterior door installation in {location}. Confirm the opening size, door swing, frame condition, hardware and finish before ordering. Exterior-door estimates should also identify threshold, weather-sealing and adjoining trim work included in the installation.

carpentry.hero: Trim carpentry in {location}, including baseboards, door casing, crown molding and selected wood repairs. Bring a profile sample or close-up photos and note whether the finish will be painted or stained so material matching and finishing are included.
carpentry.description: Trim carpentry in {location}: baseboards, door casing, crown molding and wood repairs. Request a Luna General Contractors estimate.

fencing.hero: Fence installation and repair in {location} for wood privacy fences, posts and gates. Compare the measured fence runs, height, post condition, gate openings and finish. Include removal and disposal when pricing replacement instead of comparing only a per-foot figure.
fencing.description: Fence installation and repair in {location}. Review posts, gates, materials and replacement scope with Luna General Contractors.

concrete-driveways.hero: Concrete driveway repair and replacement in {location}. Review cracked or uneven sections, drainage, access and the proposed slab details before choosing repair or replacement. Ask the estimate to distinguish demolition, base preparation, concrete placement and cleanup.
concrete-driveways.description: Concrete driveway repair and replacement in {location}. Discuss drainage, preparation and project scope with Luna General Contractors.

foundation-repair.hero: Foundation repair planning in {location} begins with an assessment of the reported movement, cracks and drainage conditions. Bring previous reports and repair records. foundation-repair.description: Discuss foundation repair planning in {location}, existing reports and evaluation needs with Luna General Contractors.

general-contractor.hero: A general contractor in {location} for remodeling, repairs and coordinated construction. Start with a room-by-room scope, priorities and material selections. general-contractor.description: General contractor in {location} for remodeling and repairs. Plan the scope and compare a written estimate with Luna General Contractors.

commercial-construction.hero: Commercial remodeling and tenant finish-out planning in {location}. Define the intended use, landlord requirements, existing conditions and work hours before pricing. commercial-construction.description: Commercial remodeling and tenant finish-outs in {location}. Discuss scope, access and coordination with Luna General Contractors.

outdoor-living.hero: Outdoor living projects in {location}, from a deck or seating area to an outdoor kitchen. Plan circulation, sun exposure, drainage and utility locations together. Identify appliances and finish selections before comparing construction scopes and estimates.
outdoor-living.description: Outdoor living projects in {location}. Plan decks, outdoor kitchens and usable backyard space with Luna General Contractors.

patio-covers.hero: Patio covers in {location}, with attached and freestanding options reviewed for the property. Discuss desired shade, rain protection, roof connections, drainage and post locations. Include planned lighting or fans when defining the construction and electrical scope.
patio-covers.description: Patio covers in {location}. Discuss attached or freestanding layouts, drainage and project scope with Luna General Contractors.

pergolas.description: Pergola installation in {location}. Plan shade, materials and backyard layout with Luna General Contractors.

insurance-claims.description: Storm and water damage repair estimates in {location}. Organize the construction scope and documentation with Luna General Contractors.
